comments.content: Dave Gandy's first Y Combinator interview, years before Font Awesome: no prep, and it went nowhere. His second, with Travis Chase: a session at the Mountain View Public Library with a childhood friend, working through Adobe Typekit comps. That one ended with a surprise second interview.

Aaand .... the Nintendo Power Glove was rushed to market in about five months, launched with a single compatible game, and only sold close to a million units thanks to the movie, "The Wizard" saying it was "so bad". BUT, the Power Glove is often cited as part of the path to the Wii Remote.
